description: Search licensed insurance companies, reinsurers, takaful operators and insurance groups across Africa, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America and North America by name. Returns matching insurers, countries and groups with their slugs and links.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Company, group or country name, or part of one.

name: search_insurers

outputSchema.description: A JSON envelope. Successful results carry dataset, version, verified and licence plus the tool’s data; failures carry error, code and retryable.

verified.description: Date the dataset snapshot was verified.

version.description: Dataset version the result was read from.

title: Search insurers, groups and countries by name
